title: Unable to open certain apps using remapping

status.label: Confirm app-launch remapping on current release
status.detail: Several app targets reportedly fail to launch, but the latest explicit version is 0.99.1 and the active shortcut and target configuration are not recorded.

judgment.rationale: The reporter describes multiple targets failing through Keyboard Manager shortcuts, and another user reports the same open-versus-closed behavior with Edge on 0.99.1. Both reports include diagnostics, but neither gives the exact trigger mapping and target installation type needed to distinguish a stale target, app activation path, or shortcut configuration. Current stable behavior is unknown.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.98.0, Windows 11 25H2, and WinGet installation.
The reporter names Terminal, PowerShell, Alacritty, Steam, Settings, and File Explorer; Settings can switch to its existing window but does not open through the mapping.
A second user reports that Edge is brought forward when already open but does not open when closed on PowerToys 0.99.1.
Both reports include PowerToys diagnostic ZIP attachments.
The issue is open and unassigned; no linked fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for one currently failing target's exact shortcut, installation source, running/closed behavior, and current PowerToys version; use the existing diagnostic attachments rather than requesting logs again.

fix_assessment.rationale: If the same target still fails on current stable, Keyboard Manager's app-target resolution or activation path may not handle that target consistently. The exact shortcut and app installation type are needed before selecting a specific code path.

proposed_fixes.title: Make shortcut-mapped app activation reliable across supported targets
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The launch/activation path selected for a remapped app shortcut may not resolve or activate some target types consistently. The current reports do not establish which target type or activation branch fails.
plan: Reproduce one currently failing target using the reporter's exact shortcut and target installation type.
Trace target resolution and activation for already-running and closed-app cases.
Correct the failing activation path while preserving existing-window foregrounding behavior.
Add focused regression coverage for launching a closed target and foregrounding an already-running target.
verification: Verify the reported target launches when closed through its configured Keyboard Manager shortcut.
Verify an already-running target is brought to the foreground without opening a blank or unrelated window.
Exercise the target installation type implicated by the reproduction.

confidence.rationale: Two reports describe a similar activation symptom, but the precise shortcut, target type, and current-release behavior are not established.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager shortcut mappings reportedly fail to open several applications; a second user says Edge only comes forward if it is already running.
known_information: The original report is from PowerToys 0.98.0 on Windows 11 25H2 installed through WinGet.
The original reporter names Terminal, PowerShell, Alacritty, Steam, Settings, and File Explorer and attached diagnostics.
A second user reports the same closed-app launch failure for Edge on 0.99.1 and attached diagnostics.
No current-release confirmation, linked fix, or exact trigger mapping is present.
inferences: The difference between foregrounding a running app and starting a closed app may indicate a target activation-path issue, but the reports do not identify the failing target type.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is suitable for targeted reproduction, but the exact shortcut and target configuration are absent. Review the existing diagnostic ZIPs before requesting any further logs.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and follow-up, including versions, target names, environment, state, labels, and diagnostic attachments.
No linked fix or additional cross-reference was found.

information_gaps.information: For one target that still fails on current stable, its exact Keyboard Manager trigger, app name and installation source, whether it is running, and the PowerToys version
information_gaps.why_needed: These details are needed to reproduce the failure and distinguish target resolution from activation or an outdated configuration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current stable, test one previously failing target while closed and while already running; report the trigger, app name, and whether it came from Microsoft Store, WinGet, or a standalone installation. No new diagnostic upload is needed.

comment.body: Thanks for listing the affected apps and attaching PowerToys reports; the Edge follow-up also helps distinguish an already-running window from a closed app. Could you confirm whether one target still fails on current stable PowerToys? Please include the exact shortcut, app name and whether it was installed from Microsoft Store, WinGet, or a standalone installer, and whether it was already running. The existing diagnostic uploads are sufficient for now; no need to upload them again.

actions.label: Reproduce app launch through a shortcut
actions.note: Use one affected target and review the existing diagnostic attachments before collecting new logs.

reproduce.title: Verify shortcut launch and foreground behavior
setup: Configure the reported Keyboard Manager shortcut for one affected app.
steps: With the target app closed, invoke the configured shortcut and observe whether it launches.
Open the target app normally, invoke the same shortcut, and observe whether its existing window is brought forward.
reproduce.expected_result: The shortcut should launch the selected application when it is closed and bring its existing window to the foreground when it is already running.
